teacher_policy: Record actual PI_MODEL/PI_PROVIDER alias when available; do not invent revisions. Existing approved agent access only.

assignments.instruction: Each group is a distinct source domain/scenario cluster. Four varied requests per cluster, not cosmetic paraphrases; distinct domains held for validation. Store domain allocation before authoring.

assignments.prepublication_correction: Use all four candidate classes and a neutral subject-preserving question template; remove original class-correlated question/candidate-set shortcuts without changing teacher judgments.
assignments.instruction: Each group is a distinct review domain/source scenario. Four varied reviews per cluster, not cosmetic paraphrases; explicit object of sentiment, no ambiguous overall label. Store domain allocation before authoring.

One distinct generator mechanism per group, frozen before cases. Hold complete generator mechanisms out for validation. Mix boundaries and outcomes; include an independently executable label audit in artifact storage if claiming rule_verified.

assembly_policy: Six split-pure shards; reject final, bad targets, duplicate IDs, exact duplicates, conflicting targets, or group leakage. Report likely duplicates for review. Tiny dataset is separate; do not concatenate it automatically.
